title: 第三章 林某报仇不隔夜新书求收藏求票票第四章 救命之恩无以为报
slug: 从效法万妖开始成就真仙
lines: 簌簌。
夜风拨动茂密的树梢，显出了墙头上的那抹白影。
青年身处高墙，靠着树身而坐，一袭贵气的毛皮大氅，仿佛戏院里的观众，独身事外。
而此刻，戏台上的目光却聚焦于他。
“林舒？”
看清来人的模样，刘三爷先前强撑镇定的狞笑，此刻变得真切了几分。
要说不慌那是假的。
此地可是西城，就自己这几人，莫说碰上城里的修士大人，随便来个官差都够他们吃一壶的。
这一激灵，彻底消去了他眼中的酒气，原本的色心也变成了杀意。
原来是这个下贱货色。
能侥幸贪得一日性命还不知足，竟敢离开院子……若再留下对方，不知要闹出多大的乱子。
“你他妈怎么跑出来的，王旭呢？”兄弟两人被打断了好事，神情悻悻。
又瞧见班主换了一副脸色，知道今晚是没戏了，那抹失落迅速化成了对林舒的暴怒。
芸娘沉默着睁开眼，瞳孔里只剩茫然。
她早猜到了来人或许没什么把握，否则也不至于在旁边蹲伏许久。
但还是没想到，来的居然是这位。
虽然没见过远处那张略显青雉的脸庞，但她曾经在戏班子游仙时看到过那套大氅，也知道婆婆是跟着对方前去报官的。
这年轻人本身也是戏班子里身不由己的可怜人罢了，又如何救得了自己和屋里的孩子。
“你害死了我婆婆，现在还要害死我们娘俩吗……快逃！”
芸娘没有去劝解此人，她知道似这种满腔热血的愣头好人，光靠几句话是劝不走的。
无奈之下，她只能满脸悲愤，用尽胸腔内最后一口气嘶吼出声，希望不要再牵连一条无辜性命。
林舒调整着呼吸，神情间明显有些失望。
虽然在前身留下的记忆里，那些学会了仙法的修士，对于普通人而言是呈碾压之势的。
但无论是前身，还是戏班子里的其他人，包括班主在内，实际上并没有人见过所谓的仙法。
为了稳妥起见，林舒还是选择了自己最擅长的方式。
毕竟他只收了那婆子一枚恶钱，算是买下了这孤儿寡母的性命，并不包括譬如清白之类的其他东西。
但他没有想到，这位刘三爷哪怕醉酒，依然警惕到了这般程度。
林舒瞥了眼手里锋利的碎瓦片，随手将其抛了出去。
咔嚓。
瓦片碎裂声中，白影从墙头跃下，稳稳落在院中。
刘三爷瞳孔微跳，要知道他是亲眼看着林舒挨了一百记实打实的鞭笞。
换做旁人早就被打死了，如今仅隔了一个下午，对方竟然跟个没事人一样。
念及此处，他手掌探向后腰，五指发力，紧紧攥住了刀柄。

;;
Rusty.
The night wind stirred the dense treetops, revealing the white shadow on the wall.
The young man is standing against a high wall, sitting against a tree, wearing a noble fur cloak, like an audience in a theater, alone and alone.
But at this moment, the eyes on the stage were focused on him.
"Lin Shu?"
Seeing the appearance of the person coming clearly, Liu Sanye's previously forced smile became more real now.
It would be a lie to say that I am not panicking.
This is the West City. Just a few of us, not to mention the monks in the city, would be enough to feed them a pot of food from any official official.
This excitement completely eliminated the smell of alcohol in his eyes, and his original lust turned into murderous intent.
It turned out to be this scumbag.
He was not satisfied with being lucky enough to survive for just one day, so he dared to leave the yard... If he were to stay with him again, he didn't know how much trouble he would cause.
"How the hell did you escape, where is Wang Xu?" The two brothers looked miserable after their good deeds were interrupted.
Seeing the class leader's expression change again, he knew that there was no chance tonight, and his disappointment quickly turned into rage towards Lin Shu.
"..."
Yun Niang opened her eyes in silence, with only confusion in her pupils.
She had already guessed that the person coming might not be sure, otherwise she wouldn't have crouched beside him for a long time.
But I still didn't expect that it was this person who came.
Although she had never seen the face that looked like a green pheasant in the distance, she had seen the big cloak when the troupe traveled to the immortals, and she also knew that her mother-in-law followed him to report to the official.
This young man himself was just a poor person in the troupe who couldn't help himself. How could he save himself and the children in the house?
"You killed my mother-in-law, are you going to kill us two now...Run away!"
Yun Niang did not try to persuade this person. She knew that such a passionate and stupid good person could not be persuaded to leave with just a few words.
In desperation, she could only scream with grief and anger on her face, using the last breath in her chest to scream, hoping not to implicate another innocent life.
"Huh."
Lin Shu adjusted his breathing, looking obviously disappointed.
Although in the memory left by his predecessor, those monks who learned the immortal method were overwhelming to ordinary people.
But neither the predecessor nor anyone else in the troupe, including the troupe leader, had actually seen the so-called immortal magic.
To be on the safe side, Lin Shu chose the method he was best at.
After all, he only received a bad amount of money from the woman, which was regarded as buying the life of the orphan and widowed mother, and other things such as innocence were not included.
But he didn't expect that Mr. Liu would still be so vigilant even if he was drunk.
Lin Shu glanced at the sharp broken tile in his hand and threw it away.
Click.
Amidst the sound of shattering tiles, Bai Ying jumped down from the wall and landed steadily in the courtyard.
Liu Sanye's pupils twitched slightly. You must know that he watched Lin Shu receive a hundred real whippings with his own eyes.
Anyone else would have been beaten to death a long time ago, but now, only one afternoon later, the other person turned out to be nothing.
Thinking of this, he reached his lower back with his palm, exerted force with his five fingers, and tightly grasped the handle of the knife.
